summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV, a Belgian-listed biotech (Euronext/NASDAQ: LKFT), filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-29 disclosing open-market repurchases under a buyback program announced 2026-06-09. Between 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-25 the company bought 106,060 ordinary shares across XAMS, TQEX, AQEU and CEUX at a volume-weighted average of EUR 26.36, for EUR 2,795,740.67, with prices from EUR 24.68 to EUR 28.34. Following settlement, Lakefront holds 1,633,594 treasury shares. This is a routine capital-return disclosure, not a special situation; no advisor, premium, or recommendation is stated. Watch pace versus prior weeks and treasury-share count for buyback-program cadence.
